reviews.title: Returned my book early
reviews.text: I pay attention to when my books are due and read them accordingly. Often I will finish a book an hour before it’s due. I know it’s not a great habit but it’s what I do. Last night Libby said that I had “1 day” left on my loan. This morning, less than 12 hours later, I find out that Libby has returned the loan that I was planning to finish today. Either Libby has changed the ui to no longer display hours and only display days or last night the api didn’t update and refresh my display. Either way I am upset that this loan was returned earlier than Libby led me to believe it would be. Fix your ui!

reviews.title: Works until you’re in a queue
reviews.text:
I have had no trouble with Libby until recently. I have been reading a popular series, so I try to time my request so it becomes available shortly after I finish a book. I didn’t time it right recently, and the next book became available too soon. I didn’t want the loan time to start ticking when I’m still reading the previous book, so I let the next person go. I thought the system would swap me with the next person. As I near the end of the book, I check the status and find my hold has been suspended. The system didn’t switch my place with the next person; it just dropped me out of the queue. Just because I’m being polite and letting the next person jump ahead doesn’t mean I want to suspend the hold entirely. 

I also have two suggestions. First, allow notices to be sent by text. I know it can be automated because I get notices from companies I have signed up for. People get a lot of notices on their phone. If they aren’t checking Libby daily for a hold, they could miss a notice. Getting it by text would help.  
Second, there needs to be a way to contact the company. I contacted my library about the problem. All they could do was sympathize, which is ridiculous. They tried to find a way to contact Libby, and there is no way to do that. There needs to be a way to contact the company when all other avenues have been tried. Since there isn’t, I’ll get your attention with two stars.
